SELECT "scd_transaction_number_primary_key" AS "transactions-base-dev.scd_transaction_number_primary_key", "row_count" AS "transactions-base-dev.row_count"
FROM (WITH RankedTransactions AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
               ORDER BY extract_time DESC
           ) AS rn
    FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions
    WHERE transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
),
JoinedData AS (
    SELECT 
        st.scd_transaction_number_primary_key
    FROM RankedTransactions st
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM asset.enterprise_security
    ) es ON st.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id AND es.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio smp 
        ON smp.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio)
        AND st.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
    LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY scd_party_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM party.enterprise_party
    ) ep ON st.counterparty_id = ep.scd_party_id AND ep.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_securities ss 
        ON st.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
        AND ss.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_securities)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_exchange_codes rec 
        ON es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
        AND rec.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_exchange_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_exchange_country 
        ON es.esm_country_code = rcc_exchange_country.country_code
        AND rcc_exchange_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country 
        ON es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
        AND rcc_incorp_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY portfolio_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS latest
        FROM reference.scd_portfolio
    ) sp ON sp.latest = 1 AND sp.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_trade_country 
        ON rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
        AND rcc_trade_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            abor_transaction_number,
            business_date,
            transaction_cancellation_flag,
            trade_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY abor_transaction_number
                ORDER BY business_date DESC
            ) AS latest
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transaction_cost
        WHERE transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
    ) stc
    ON stc.latest = 1
       AND st.abor_transaction_number = stc.abor_transaction_number
       AND st.transaction_cancellation_flag = stc.transaction_cancellation_flag
       AND st.trade_date = stc.trade_date
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id, portfolio_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main
    ) shm ON shm.abor_security_id = st.abor_security_id
        AND shm.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
        AND shm.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes rcc 
        ON st.quotation_currency = rcc.currency_code
        AND rcc.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_currency_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY model_portfolio ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
    ) spif
        ON spif.model_portfolio = st.model_portfolio_id
        AND spif.rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    scd_transaction_number_primary_key,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM JoinedData
WHERE scd_transaction_number_primary_key IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY row_count DESC) AS "transactions_base"
LIMIT 1000

/* cppi::c6723b1427c288b7ba7ca0f54bd42b3b7f6e0e8297ad66622b3b50098f321d34 */
SELECT pv.BUSINESS_DATE                               AS "RPT_DTE",
       h.INVESTMENT_DEPT,
       h.INVESTMENT_STRAT,
       pos.PTFL_ACCT_CODE                             AS "SCD Model Portfolio",
       pos.SECURITY_GROUP_NAME                        AS "Product Group",
       pos.HOLKEYIK                                   AS "SCD Holding Key",
       pos.POS_SHORT_DESC                             AS "Position Description",
       CAST(pv.abacus_pv_base_ccy AS DECIMAL(33, 15)) AS "Present Value Base Cur",

         JOIN dim_pos_inst pos ON
    pv.chron_id = pos.chron_id and pv.pos_id = pos.pos_id
         LEFT OUTER JOIN MV_DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_RISK h ON
    h.chron_id = pos.chron_id and pos.PTFL_ACCT_CODE = h.MODEL_PORTFOLIO
         LEFT JOIN ref_legal_entity issuer_le ON

         LEFT JOIN ref_legal_entity cp_le ON
        cp_le.chron_id = pos.chron_id and pos.counter_party_id = cp_le.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
         LEFT JOIN ref_legal_entity fundmgr_le ON
        fundmgr_le.chron_id = pos.chron_id and pos.fund_manager_id = fundmgr_le.LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
WHERE pos.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = 'IP'
  AND h.MODEL_PORTFOLIO IS NULL
  and pv.business_date = '2025-06-05'
ORDER BY pos.PTFL_ACCT_CODE

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 06
		AND hour between 17 and 18
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-06 17:45:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 06
		AND hour between 04 and 05
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-06 04:38:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

from

    pv.hierarchy_level = 'category' and 
    pv.node_name in ( 'EQUITY', 'FINANCE') and
    pv.business_date = '2025-06-05'

           LOT.current_price,
           LOT.current_price_currency,
           LOT.custody_account_code,
           LOT.deal_type,
           LOT.delta,
           LOT.fx_rate_base_currency,
           LOT.fx_rate_quoted_in_cad,
           LOT.fx_rate_quoted_in_usd,
           LOT.gamma,
           LOT.id_broker,
           LOT.id_broker_source,
           LOT.id_instrument,
           LOT.id_instrument_alternate,
           LOT.id_sub_trade_source,
           LOT.instrument_alternate_id_type,
           LOT.instrument_family_name_source,
           LOT.instrument_group_name_source,
           LOT.instrument_id_type,
           LOT.instrument_last_tradeable_date,
           LOT.instrument_lot_size,
           LOT.instrument_name,
           LOT.instrument_option_expiry_date,
           LOT.instrument_option_type,
           LOT.instrument_strike_price,
           LOT.instrument_strike_price_currency,
           LOT.instrument_sub_type,
           LOT.instrument_type,
           LOT.market_value,
           LOT.market_value_currency,
           LOT.past_cash_flows_proceeds,
           LOT.past_cash_flows_proceeds_currency,
           LOT.premium_amount,
           case
               when LOT.instrument_family_name_source = 'IRD' then
                   abs(LOT.quantity) * abs(LOT.instrument_lot_size)
               else
                   abs(LOT.quantity) * abs(LOT.instrument_lot_size) * LOT.underlying_current_price
               end
           as current_nominal,
           case
               when LOT.instrument_family_name_source = 'IRD' then
                   LOT.fx_rate_quoted_in_cad * abs(LOT.quantity) * abs(LOT.instrument_lot_size)
               else
                   LOT.fx_rate_quoted_in_cad * abs(LOT.quantity) * abs(LOT.instrument_lot_size) * LOT.underlying_current_price
               end
           as current_nominal_pc,
           LOT.market_value + LOT.future_cash_flows  as clean_market_value,
           (LOT.market_value + LOT.future_cash_flows) * fx_rate_quoted_in_cad  as clean_market_value_pc,
           LOT.market_value                          as market_value_mv,
           LOT.market_value * fx_rate_quoted_in_cad  as market_value_base_mv,
           LOT.current_price_currency                as current_notional_currency,
           LOT.market_value_currency,
           LOT.premium_amount_currency,
           LOT.premium_payment_date,
           LOT.previous_price_currency,
           LOT.quantity,
           LOT.rho,
           LOT.settlement_date,
           LOT.sub_trade_source_id_type,
           LOT.theta,
           LOT.trade_date,
           LOT.trade_id,
           LOT.trade_price,
           LOT.trade_price_currency,
           LOT.trade_status,
           LOT.trade_strategy_name,
           LOT.trader_name,
           LOT.trading_portfolio_code,
           LOT.underlying_current_price,
           LOT.vanna,
           LOT.vega,
           LOT.future_cash_flows
    FROM trades_deals.listed_options_trades LOT
    WHERE business_date = date '2025-06-05'
    and id_instrument !='0'
) as a
left join
(
    select id_instrument,
           LOP.instrument_type_name_source       AS Position_instrument_type_name_source,
           LOP.underlying_current_price_currency AS Position_underlying_current_price_currency
    FROM trades_deals.listed_options_positions  LOP
    WHERE business_date = date '2025-06-05'
    and id_instrument !='0'
) as b
    on a.id_instrument = b.id_instrument
left join
(
    select cast(cppib_sec_id as VARCHAR) as cppib_sec_id_new,
           underlying_instrument_cppib_sec_id,
           expiration_date,
           exercise_type,
           instrument_description,
           exchange_name,
           country_code,
           ticker,
           underlying_instrument_bloomberg_unique_id,
           underlying_instrument_currency_code,
           underlying_instrument_isin,
           underlying_instrument_spot_ticker,
           underlying_instrument_ticker,
           underlying_instrument_ticker_exchange_code,
           underlying_instrument_warrant_underlying_type,
           sub_type,
           mic,
           region_code,
           market_sector_description,
           bloomberg_exchange,
           document_type,
           bloomberg_unique_id,
           currency_code,
           delete_date,
           expiration_date
    from asset.asset_options
    where business_date = date '2025-06-05'
) as c
    on a.id_instrument = c.cppib_sec_id_new
left join
(
    select trading_portfolio_code,
           id_model_portfolio
    from finance_accounting.murex_scd_model_portfolios_mapping
      where business_date = date '2025-06-05'
) as d
    on d.trading_portfolio_code = a.trading_portfolio_code
left join
(
    select id_model_portfolio,
           unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
    from finance_accounting.model_portfolios
    where business_date = date '2025-06-05'
) as e
    on d.id_model_portfolio = e.id_model_portfolio
left join
(
    select cppib_sec_id,
           cppib_currency_of_exposure_code
    from asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications
    where business_date = date '2025-06-05'
) as f
    on cast(f.cppib_sec_id as varchar) = a.id_instrument
left join
(
    select cppib_party_id,
           party_name,
           domicile_country_code,
           incorp_country_code,
           bloomberg_company_id
    from party.party
    where business_date = date '2025-06-05'
) as p
    on cast(p.cppib_party_id as varchar) = a.id_broker
left join
(
    select sub_type as underlying_instrument_sub_type,
           type as underlying_instrument_type,
           exchange_name as underlying_instrument_exchange_name,
           mic as underlying_instrument_mic,
           country_code as underlying_instrument_country_code,
           last_tradeable_date as underlying_instrument_maturity_date,
           instrument_description as underlying_instrument_description,
           instrument_name as underlying_instrument_name,
           region_code as underlying_instrument_region_code,
           market_sector_description as underlying_instrument_market_sector,
           contract_size as underlying_instrument_contract_size,
           bloomberg_exchange as underlying_instrument_bloomberg_exchange,
           cppib_party_id as underlying_cppib_party_id,
           cppib_sec_id as underlying_instrument_cppib_sec_id,
           delete_date as underlying_delete_date,
           last_delivered_date as last_delivered_date
    from asset.asset_futures
    where business_date = date '2025-06-05'
) as u
    on u.underlying_instrument_cppib_sec_id = c.underlying_instrument_cppib_sec_id
left join
(
    select cppib_party_id as u_cppib_party_id,
           party_name as u_party_name,
           domicile_country_code as u_domicile_country_code,
           incorp_country_code as u_incorp_country_code,
           bloomberg_company_id as u_bloomberg_company_id
    from party.party
    where business_date = date '2025-06-05'
) as up
    on up.u_cppib_party_id = u.underlying_cppib_party_id
left join
(
    select cppib_sec_id as underlying_instrument_cppib_sec_id,
           cppib_currency_of_exposure_code as underlying_instrument_cppib_currency_of_exposure_code
    from asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications
    where business_date = date '2025-06-05'
) as uf
    on uf.underlying_instrument_cppib_sec_id = c.underlying_instrument_cppib_sec_id
